caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure resembling a Native American man positioned on a rectangular black base with a smaller green platform under his front foot. He is wearing a yellowish-tan a long-sleeved tunic adorned with a decorative trim around the collar and hem, and a dark brown, textured apron or skirt-like garment over it, held in place with a belt. The figure has a necklace with round beads or decorations around his neck. His footwear consists of similarly colored moccasins with a band detail. He has dark brown skin and dark, medium-length hair, and is wearing a wide, tall feathered headdress with feathers colored in a gradient of light brown, yellow, and blue. His right hand is extended and holds a brown mug or tankard, while his left hand hangs by his side, partially clenched. The entire statue is rendered in a realistic, detailed style with clear emphasis on color and texture. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Cigar Store Indian
